title: Your First 5K
successfulCompletionCriteria: Proposed: measured 5 km outing; distinguish walking, run-walk and continuous achievement; certificate eligibility pending final confirmation.
unresolved: Replace overly restrictive combined weekly gates with session-based progression and four-week review checkpoints
Improve coordination of practice and longer outing so demonstrated longer bouts can transfer without an unsupported running-volume jump
Retest six complete journeys with distinct running and walking speeds; check realistic completion pathways rather than requiring a promised deadline
Integrate persistent return, safety, frequency, pace substitutions, goal change and acknowledgment state
Confirm primary finish goal and certificate eligibility
Complete programming, research, accessibility, device and beginner gates
notes: Version 4 prototype. 12 scripted profiles and 29 additional checks passed. Six exploratory journeys: one completion, five incomplete after 80 simulated weeks. Generated bridge workouts now progress, but timing and long-outing strategy adoption remain too restrictive. No release gates approved.

goalPaceNotice.heading: Let's build toward your goal.
goalPaceNotice.body: Your workouts will start at a pace that fits your current fitness. As you progress, we'll revisit your target pace and begin working toward it when your training supports it. You can keep your original goal or change it at any time.
goalPaceNotice.behavior: Save acknowledgment locally per goal revision; dismiss repeated notice; never bypass pace eligibility. Reconsider when new training evidence changes eligibility. Never label a goal unrealistic in user-facing text.
